summary: Liu–Zhu prove rigidity for p-adic local systems on a connected smooth rigid variety: a local system that is de Rham at one classical point is de Rham at every classical point. They construct a p-adic Riemann–Hilbert functor to filtered vector bundles with integrable connection, compatible with pullback and pushforward, and apply it to Shimura varieties. Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed, and twelve findings are recorded against arXiv v3. Lemma 3.10's quantifier is wrong (E06); the main theorems are unaffected. Not formalised.

items.name: De Rham and geometric representations
items.statement: For a finite-dimensional continuous Qp representation V of G_k, DdR(V)=(V⊗BdR)^Gk and V is de Rham when dim_k DdR(V)=dim_Qp V. For a number field E, geometric means unramified at all but finitely many finite places and de Rham at every place above p.

items.name: Analytic local systems and completed coefficients
items.statement: On a rigid analytic X/k use locally constant finite free Z/p^n sheaves with compatible Zp lattices and their rational Qp local systems; pass to associated completed sheaves hatL on the proétale site. Keep the p-adic coefficient topology.

items.statement: For locally noetherian analytic X, use Scholze proétale objects and the corrigendum covering condition: transfinite successive pullbacks of finite étale surjections, with limit-stage surjectivity. Construct ν:X_proet→X_et and base-change ν′ over K.

items.name: Affinoid coherence and Tate acyclicity
items.statement: For an affinoid rigid space over a complete nonarchimedean field, coherent sheaves correspond to finite modules, vector bundles to finite projective modules, and coherent higher cohomology vanishes; use actual completed restriction maps.

items.name: Affinoid-perfectoid vector-bundle descent and acyclicity
items.statement: For affinoid perfectoid U in X_proet and finite locally free hatO_X-module M, H^q(X_proet/U,M)=0 for q>0. Its evaluation descends to a finite projective module on the associated affinoid perfectoid space.

items.name: Structural de Rham period sheaves
items.statement: Construct O_BdR+ on X_proet by sheafifying the finite-level colimit of kerθ-completions of (O_X+(U_j) p-completed-tensor Ainf(U))[1/p]. Theta lands in the completed ring on U. Construct O_BdR, filtration and integrable connection.

items.statement: Define OC=gr^0 O_BdR with gr^j O_BdR=OC(j) and gr∇:OC→OC⊗Ω¹_X(-1). The Higgs field is O_X-linear and square-zero in exterior degree two.

items.name: Period interval acyclicity
items.statement: For affinoid perfectoid U and a Qp local system L, H^q(U,hatL⊗O_BdR^[a,b])=0 for q>0 for all finite or infinite intervals allowed by the separated complete filtration; graded OC coefficients are included.

items.name: Cohomological colimits and derived limits
items.statement: On the coherent proétale slices used here, filtered colimits commute with the specified cohomology functors; for the surjective period-quotient towers, the applicable derived-limit statement controls lim¹ and gives the unbounded-interval comparison.

items.name: Finite-descent étale basis
items.statement: Let B consist of standard étale Y→X_k′ for finite k′⊂K, with toric charts after finite enlargement; regard them over K. Morphisms descend to some finite common k′.

items.name: Finite descent of étale morphisms
items.statement: The base-change functor defining P13 is full and its image covers (X_K)_et. Roots descend after a finite extension using finite Shilov boundary, Krasner approximation and Ax–Sen–Tate invariants B_K^Gal(K/k′)=B_k′.

items.name: Finite-projective étale gluing
items.statement: A compatible assignment Y↦M(Y) of finite projective B_K modules on the basis P13, with scalar-extension isomorphisms for standard étale maps and cocycle compatibility, defines a vector bundle on X_K.

items.name: Koszul complexes of commuting endomorphisms
items.statement: For a module M and a finite family of pairwise commuting linear endomorphisms D_i, form the cochain Koszul complex with degree-j direct sums indexed by j-subsets and alternating differential. Ring-element Koszul complexes are special cases.

items.name: Continuous Cartan–Leray and procyclic cochains
items.statement: For the affinoid-perfectoid torsors and continuous Qp-Banach coefficients in this paper, identify proétale cohomology with continuous Γ-cohomology. For a suitable torsion-free procyclic Γ generated by γ, compute by [M→M], γ−1, in degrees0,1. Finite rational descent is exact, including p=2.

items.name: Coherent connections are locally free
items.statement: A coherent module with integrable connection on a smooth rigid analytic variety over a characteristic-zero field is locally free.

items.name: Integrable connections on ringed differential sites
items.statement: Given a ringed site with a differential graded algebra Ω• and derivation d, a connection on finite locally free E is additive and satisfies ∇(ae)=a∇e+e⊗da; its extension to forms squares to zero when integrable. This general carrier precedes the quasi-nilpotent crystalline specialization.

items.name: Twisted nilpotent Higgs bundles
items.statement: For a locally free Ω¹ and invertible twist T on a ringed site, a Higgs bundle is finite locally free E with O-linear θ:E→E⊗Ω¹⊗T and θ∧θ=0. Nilpotent means a finite filtration whose graded Higgs fields vanish, equivalently the locally commuting action is nilpotent in the finite-rank setting used here.

api.name: LiuZhu17.H02.characterise

items.name: Filtered and parameter connections
items.statement: For a central parameter λ with dλ=0, a λ-connection satisfies ∇λ(ae)=a∇λ(e)+λe⊗da. A Griffiths filtration on an ordinary connection satisfies ∇Fil^j⊂Fil^(j−1)⊗Ω¹; associated graded carries the induced Higgs field.

api.name: LiuZhu17.H03.characterise

api.name: LiuZhu17.H03.transport
api.statement: For λ invertible recover an ordinary connection by λ^-1∇λ, and construct filtered pullback.

items.name: Arithmetic p-adic Simpson functor
items.statement: For smooth rigid X/k and a Qp local system L, set H(L)=ν′_*(hatL⊗OC) on (X_K)_et with Higgs field induced by gr∇ and semilinear Gal(K/k) action. Theorems below prove it is a rank-preserving nilpotent Higgs bundle.

items.statement: On a standard étale chart Y over the n-torus, adjoin p^m roots of all torus coordinates and cyclotomic roots; distinguish the relative tower over k from its geometric K-base change. Construct Γgeom≃Zp(1)^n, Γ≃Γgeom⋊Gal(K/k), and the associated affinoid-perfectoid completions.

items.name: Polynomial period coordinates
items.statement: On the geometric toric tower, OC=hatO[V_1,…,V_n] with V_i=t^-1 log([T_i^flat]/T_i), γ_s(V_i)=V_i+δsi, and gr∇V_i=−t^-1 dlogT_i.

items.name: Locally decompleting towers and relative period modules
items.statement: For a weakly decompleting finite étale tower ψ, decompleting means the Frobenius quotient complex in KL2v1 Definition5.6.1 is exact at every sufficiently high level. Locally decompleting also requires stable uniformity and this property after every rational localization. Construct perfect/imperfect Robba-period Γ-modules and Frobenius-linearization isomorphisms, with globally étale subcategories distinguished.

items.name: Toric decompletion and étale equivalence
items.statement: Geometric toric towers over perfectoid fields and relative toric towers over p-adic fields are locally decompleting. In the KL2v1 hypotheses, the scalar-extension functors between globally étale finite-projective (φ,Γ)-modules over the displayed perfect/imperfect period rings are exact tensor equivalences and identify with the corresponding isogeny local systems.

items.name: Strict quotient cochains and theta specialization
items.statement: For a sufficiently small interval 0<s≤r/p and m with p^m s≤1≤p^m r, the perfect/imperfect relative-period quotient cochains are strictly exact. Their theta specialization yields the cocartesian squares(2.27), with imperfect image B_m or B_(K,m), and identifies analytic and continuous cohomology in the stated coefficient category.

api.statement: Prove its completed scalar extension equals M.

api.name: LiuZhu17.T07.transport
api.statement: Transport to larger levels and along standard étale maps.

uses.how: Intermediate finite descent before the canonical unipotent summand.

items.name: Toric descent cohomology comparison
items.statement: For T07 and every q≥0, H^q_cont(Γgeom,M_m(Y)⊗_(B_km)B_K)→H^q_cont(Γgeom,M(geometric tower)) is an isomorphism, compatibly with standard étale base change.

items.name: Arithmetic quasi-unipotence
items.statement: The B_K-linear Γgeom action on M_(K,m)=M_m⊗k_m K is quasi-unipotent. A sufficiently small geometric γ has nilpotent logγ.

items.name: Canonical unipotent toric module
items.statement: Define M_K(Y) as the generalized trivial-character part after sufficiently high finite-level descent and cancellation of finite Γgeom characters by fractional torus monomials. It is the unique finite-projective B_K submodule of the completed M that is Γ-stable, has unipotent B_K-linear Γgeom action and recovers M after completed tower scalar extension.

api.name: LiuZhu17.T10.construct
api.statement: Construct the trivial generalized-character summand and its inclusion in completed M.

api.name: LiuZhu17.T10.characterise
api.statement: Prove the three characterizing properties and uniqueness using toric generalized eigenvectors.

api.name: LiuZhu17.T10.transport
api.statement: Prove independence of enlarged finite level and standard étale compatibility.

uses.how: Canonical local object underlying H.

items.name: Finite arithmetic descent and unipotent cohomology
items.statement: M_K(Y) descends to a Γ-stable finite-projective B_km0 module M(Y), compatibly with standard étale base change.

items.name: Logarithmic Higgs field
items.statement: For M_K(Y), define commuting nilpotent Higgs operators by logγ_i=t·θ(T_i∂/∂T_i). Assemble θ:M_K→M_K⊗Ω¹_Y(-1); the Tate factor makes it independent of the chosen cyclotomic trivialization.

api.name: LiuZhu17.T12.construct
api.statement: Construct the finite nilpotent logarithms and θ.

api.name: LiuZhu17.T12.characterise
api.statement: Identify exp(tθ_i)=γ_i and prove θ∧θ=0.

api.name: LiuZhu17.T12.transport
api.statement: Prove generator, coordinate and cyclotomic-trivialization compatibility.

uses.how: Identify the period-sheaf Higgs field.

items.name: Translation invariants and surjective difference
items.statement: For a Q-vector space W with automorphism γ, let γ act on W[V] by γ(wV^i)=γ(w)(V+1)^i. Evaluation at V=0 identifies invariants with ⋃_N ker(γ−1)^N. If every vector is generalized invariant, γ−1 on W[V] is surjective.

items.name: Polynomial period invariants and higher vanishing
items.statement: For Y in B, H^q(Y_(K,proet),hatL⊗OC) equals M_K(Y) for q=0 and vanishes for q>0, equivariantly for Gal(K/k).

items.name: Identification and sign of the Higgs field
items.statement: Under H(L)(Y_K)≃M_K(Y), the field induced by gr∇ is the logarithmic θ. On M_K[V], total Θ=θ+t^-1Σ∂_(V_i)dlogT_i, whereas gr∇=−t^-1Σ∂_(V_i)dlogT_i; restriction to kerΘ gives θ.

items.name: Nilpotent p-adic Simpson bundle
items.statement: For a Qp local system L on smooth X/k, H(L) is a rank-rkL vector bundle on X_K with nilpotent Higgs field and semilinear Gal(K/k) action.

items.name: Higgs period reconstruction
items.statement: There is a canonical equivariant isomorphism ν′*H(L)⊗OC≃hatL⊗OC, intertwining the tensor Higgs field θ_H+gr∇ with gr∇ on the coefficient factor.

items.name: Finite-projective pullback on perfectoid slices
items.statement: For f:Z→X and finite locally free hatO_X-module M, evaluation on affinoid perfectoid V→U gives (f_proet* M)(V)=M(U)⊗_(hatO_X(U))hatO_Z(V), with the completed ring maps and the finite-projective tensor convention.

items.name: Arbitrary smooth-space pullback of Simpson
items.statement: For any morphism f:Z→X of smooth rigid k-varieties, f_K*H(L)≃H(f*L), compatibly with Higgs fields and Galois actions.

items.name: Simpson tensor compatibility
items.statement: H(L1⊗L2)≃H(L1)⊗H(L2), with sum Higgs field and diagonal Galois action, naturally and associatively.

items.name: Simpson unit and dual
items.statement: H(Qp)≃(O_XK,0) with its natural semilinear Galois action.

items.name: Relative Higgs Poincaré lemma
items.statement: For smooth f:X→Y, the augmented complex 0→f_proet*OC_Y→OC_X→OC_X⊗Ω¹_X/Y(-1)→… is exact with the induced relative gr∇.

items.name: Smooth proper period projection formula
items.statement: For smooth proper f:X→Y between smooth rigid varieties and a locally free O_X-module M on X_proet, the natural map Rf_proet,*M ⊗_(O_Y)OC_Y→Rf_proet,*(M⊗_(O_X)f_proet*OC_Y) is an isomorphism.

items.name: Smooth proper Higgs direct image
items.statement: Let f:X→Y be smooth proper between smooth rigid k-varieties and L a Zp local system such that every R^q f_*L is a Zp local system. Then H((R^i f_*L)⊗Qp)≃R^i f_(Higgs),*H(L⊗Qp), where relative Higgs degree j is H(L)⊗Ω^j_X/Y(-j), with the induced Gauss–Manin Higgs structure.

items.name: Proper étale–Higgs cohomology comparison
items.statement: For proper smooth X/k and a Qp local system L admitting a Zp lattice, H^i_et(X_Cp,L)⊗Cp≃H^i_Higgs(X_Cp,H(L)), equivariantly.

items.name: Simpson external products
items.statement: For smooth X,Y/k and local systems L,M, H(L⊠M)≃H(L)⊠H(M), equivariantly for Galois and with the sum Higgs field.

items.name: Kummer local-system calculation
items.statement: For X=Gm^an, ζ_(p^m)∈k and π:T_m→T the p^m-Kummer cover, L=π_*Zp has M_K=⊕_(a mod p^m) A_K·T^(-a/p^m)⊗τ_a. Its geometric Γ action and Higgs field are trivial although the local system is nontrivial and is not small in the cited integral Faltings sense.

items.name: Completed de Rham base sheaves
items.statement: For a basis object Y=Spa(B,B+) over finite k′⊂K, define O_Xhat⊗(BdR+/t^n) by Bhat⊗_k′(BdR+/t^n), n≥1; sheafify compatibly, take inverse limit for the plus sheaf and invert t for the full sheaf.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R01.construct
api.statement: Construct finite quotients, inverse limit and t-inversion in this order.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R01.characterise
api.statement: Identify sections on each basis object with the completed tensor formula.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R01.transport
api.statement: Prove independence of finite field of definition and restriction compatibility.

uses.how: Construct the ringed BdR base without a fictitious K embedding.

items.name: Finite period quotient acyclicity
items.statement: For X=Spa(A,A+) and every n≥1, H^q((X_K)_et,O_Xhat⊗(BdR+/t^n)) equals Ahat⊗_k(BdR+/t^n) for q=0 and vanishes for q>0.
items.locator: Lemma3.1 with independent cohomology and truncation indices

items.name: Graded period base sheaf
items.statement: For each j∈Z, gr^j(O_Xhat⊗BdR)=O_XK(j), compatibly with restriction and semilinear Galois action.

items.name: Finite-projective modules on the period base
items.statement: For smooth affinoid X=Spa(A,A+), finite-projective modules over Ahat⊗BdR+/t^n, and over Ahat⊗BdR+, correspond to finite locally free sheaves on the analytic or étale ringed sites. The analytic-to-étale pullback is an equivalence.

items.name: The ringed de Rham base
items.statement: Define X+=(X_K,O_Xhat⊗BdR+) and X_BdR=(X_K,O_Xhat⊗BdR) on the analytic site, with their étale analogues. These are ringed spaces; no representability as an ordinary rigid variety over BdR is asserted.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R05.construct
api.statement: Construct the ringed spaces and analytic/étale comparison morphism.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R05.characterise
api.statement: Identify reduction of X+ modulo t with X_K.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R05.transport
api.statement: Construct pullback from a morphism of smooth rigid k-varieties.

uses.how: Target geometry for RH.

items.name: Filtered period vector bundles with lattices
items.statement: A vector bundle on X_BdR is locally free of finite rank and must admit an X+ lattice E+ with E+[1/t]≃E. A filtered object has a decreasing filtration by O_Xhat⊗BdR+ submodules with t^i Fil^j=Fil^(i+j), and the RH construction provides locally free filtration lattices.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R06.construct
api.statement: Construct an object with its admitted plus lattice and exhaustive separated t-filtration.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R06.characterise
api.statement: Identify the full bundle as lattice localization and gr^j through t^j transport.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R06.transport
api.statement: Construct tensor, dual and filtered pullback with lattice comparison maps.

uses.how: State the genuine target category.

items.name: Relative filtered de Rham complexes
items.statement: On X_BdR use BdR-linear integrable connections relative to the original smooth k-space and Ω^j_Xhat⊗BdR. A filtered connection satisfies Griffiths transversality. For smooth f:X→Y define relative de Rham hypercohomology with its induced connection on Y_BdR.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R07.construct
api.statement: Construct the connection-valued de Rham complex and filtered differential.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R07.characterise
api.statement: Prove d²=0 and identify the relative differential sequence for smooth f.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R07.transport
api.statement: Construct pullback, tensor connections and the Gauss–Manin connection on permitted direct images.

uses.how: Target of geometric RH and its pushforward.

items.name: Untwisted period-sheaf direct image
items.statement: For any permitted interval [a,b], Rν′_*O_BdR^[a,b]≃(O_Xhat⊗BdR)^[a,b], and the analogous identity holds after tensoring Ω^j. All higher pushforwards vanish.

items.name: Geometric Riemann–Hilbert functor
items.statement: For a Qp local system L on smooth X/k define RH(L)=ν′_*(hatL⊗O_BdR), its filtration by period intervals, and its induced BdR-linear connection and semilinear Gal(K/k) action. Define RH+(L)=Fil^0 RH(L).

api.name: LiuZhu17.R09.construct
api.statement: Construct RH on objects and local-system morphisms.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R09.characterise
api.statement: Identify Fil^j sections with the filtered period pushforward.

api.name: LiuZhu17.R09.transport
api.statement: Construct tensor and pullback comparison morphisms before proving they are isomorphisms.

uses.how: Geometric object whose Galois cohomology yields arithmetic DdR.

items.name: Filtered Riemann–Hilbert bundle and vanishing
items.statement: RH(L) has rank rkL and a locally free plus lattice, with semilinear Galois action and integrable connection satisfying Griffiths transversality.

items.name: Filtered period reconstruction
items.statement: The adjunction map ν′*RH(L)⊗O_BdR→hatL⊗O_BdR is an isomorphism compatible with filtration, the tensor connection and Galois actions.

items.name: Associated graded of Riemann–Hilbert
items.statement: gr^0 RH(L)≃H(L) with its Higgs field, and gr^j RH(L)≃H(L)(j).

items.name: Arbitrary pullback of Riemann–Hilbert
items.statement: For any f:Y→X of smooth rigid k-varieties, f*RH_X(L)≃RH_Y(f*L), with filtration, connection and Galois action.

items.name: Riemann–Hilbert tensor structure
items.statement: RH is a tensor functor: it preserves unit, tensor products and duals together with connection, filtration, Galois action and the coherence isomorphisms.

items.name: Smooth proper Riemann–Hilbert pushforward
items.statement: For smooth proper f:X→Y between smooth rigid k-varieties and a Zp local system L with all R^q f_*L locally constant finite free, RH((R^i f_*L)⊗Qp)≃R^i f_dR,* RH(L⊗Qp) as filtered bundles with integrable connection and Galois action.

items.name: The t-connection interpolation
items.statement: The plus lattice RH+(L) with ∇+=t∇ is a t-connection. Modulo t it yields H(L) with the Tate-normalized Higgs field; after inverting t and dividing ∇+ by t it yields RH(L) with its ordinary connection.

items.name: Arithmetic de Rham direct images
items.statement: Define D^i_dR(L)=R^iν_*(hatL⊗O_BdR) on X_et with the induced connection. Via Cartan–Leray these are continuous Gal(K/k)-cohomology sheaves of the geometric RH object. For general L no full-rank admissibility is assumed.

api.name: LiuZhu17.A01.construct
api.statement: Construct the arithmetic derived pushforwards and connection.

api.name: LiuZhu17.A01.characterise
api.statement: Identify their local sections with the specified continuous Galois cohomology when the acyclicity hypotheses hold.

api.name: LiuZhu17.A01.transport
api.statement: Construct pullback and comparison maps, with later base-change theorems supplying isomorphisms.

uses.how: Arithmetic realization whose local freeness proves rigidity.

items.name: Normalized trace complement
items.statement: For k∞=∪k_m and K its completion, extend normalized traces to bounded projections R_m:K→k_m and put X_m=ker R_m, so K=k_m⊕X_m. Tensor with the finite affinoid modules using the specified Banach topology.

api.name: LiuZhu17.A02.construct
api.statement: Construct normalized traces and their continuous extension.

api.name: LiuZhu17.A02.characterise
api.statement: Prove the topological direct-sum decomposition and Γ-equivariance.

api.name: LiuZhu17.A02.transport
api.statement: Construct compatible larger-level projections and completed coefficient extension.

uses.how: Tate–Sen inverse and perturbation argument.

items.name: Correct Tate–Sen inverse condition
items.statement: For large m and a chosen generator γ of Gal(k∞/k_m), hence v_p(χ(γ)−1)=m after stable indexing, γ−1 is continuously invertible on X_m with a uniform inverse bound. More generally the scalar Tate–Sen condition has n(γ)≤m, not ≥m.

items.name: Finite-module cyclotomic decompletion
items.statement: Let M be a finite A_m0-module with continuous semilinear Gal(k∞/k) action. For sufficiently large m, choose a generator γ of Gal(k∞/k_m). Then γ−1 is continuously invertible on (Mhat⊗k_m0 K)/(M⊗k_m0 k_m). Consequently finite-level inclusion gives an isomorphism on all continuous Galois cohomology groups.

items.name: Graded cyclotomic finiteness and weight bounds
items.statement: For the finite-descent module M(X) of Proposition2.8(P1), H^i(Gal(k∞/k),H(L)(X_K)(j)) is a finite A-module, zero for i≥2 and for |j| sufficiently large. These groups commute with standard étale base change.

items.name: Finite cohomology of period windows
items.statement: For every finite interval [a,b], Galois cohomology of RH^[a,b](L)(X_K) is finite over A, vanishes in degrees≥2, and stabilizes to D^i_dR(L) as the ends leave the finite range allowed by A05.

items.name: Local freeness of all arithmetic realizations
items.statement: For smooth X/k and any Qp local system L, every D^i_dR(L) is a vector bundle with integrable connection.

items.name: Nonflat cohomology base change criterion
items.statement: For a two-term complex of flat A-modules concentrated in degrees0,1 with both cohomology modules flat over A, its cohomology commutes with arbitrary algebraic base change A→B. Without flat cohomology retain the Tor correction.

items.name: Analytic period-window base change
items.statement: For smooth toric affinoids X=Spa(A),Y=Spa(B), f:Y→X, a Zp local system L on X and finite [a,b], H^i(Γ,RH^[a,b](L)(X_K))⊗_A B→H^i(Γ,RH^[a,b](f*L)(Y_K)) is an isomorphism for all i.

items.name: Arbitrary pullback of arithmetic realizations
items.statement: For every morphism f:Y→X of smooth rigid k-varieties and every i≥0, f*D^i_dR(L)≃D^i_dR(f*L), compatibly with the integrable connections.

items.name: One de Rham stalk gives strict filtration
items.statement: Assume X is connected and smooth and L has one classical de Rham stalk. The period-filtration spectral sequence degenerates at E1; D^0_dR(L) has a decreasing filtration by subbundles satisfying Griffiths transversality, and arbitrary pullback A10 preserves that filtration.

items.name: De Rham local-system comparison
items.statement: Under A11’s hypotheses, L is de Rham in Scholze’s sense: the filtered integrable bundle (D^0_dR(L),∇,Fil) reconstructs hatL⊗O_BdR through the filtered horizontal comparison map.

items.name: First arithmetic direct image in the de Rham case
items.statement: Under A11’s hypotheses, D^1_dR(L) is isomorphic to D^0_dR(L). No canonical normalization of this isomorphism is claimed without specifying the cyclotomic cohomology generator.

items.name: Tensor de Rham realization
items.statement: On the category of de Rham Qp local systems on a smooth rigid k-space, D^0_dR is a tensor functor to filtered vector bundles with integrable connection satisfying Griffiths transversality.

items.name: Geometric rigidity of de Rham stalks
items.statement: For geometrically connected rigid analytic X over a finite extension k/Qp, a Qp local system with one classical de Rham stalk has every classical stalk de Rham and all their Hodge–Tate weight multisets equal. X need not be smooth.

items.name: Hodge–Tate and period recovery for de Rham systems
items.statement: A de Rham Qp local system on smooth X/k is Hodge–Tate; H(L) is identified with the graded DdR bundle with its specified twists.

items.name: Resolution, compactification and arithmetic spreading
items.statement: In characteristic zero, use the source-qualified algebraic or rigid resolution theorem, smooth compactifications for the algebraic smooth case, and spread the algebraic data over O_E[1/N] with smooth projective compactification and boundary after enlarging N. Keep connected and irreducible components distinct.
items.locator: Proofs of Theorem1.3 and Proposition4.1; Bierstone–Milman

items.name: Congruence frame torsors and branch divisors
items.statement: For a rank-n Zp local system on a smooth number-field variety and m≥1, take the finite étale frame torsor of L/p^m with group GL_n(Z/p^m). Normalize a chosen compactification model in its finite étale generic algebra, retaining all components; separate the branch divisor into vertical and horizontal parts.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G02.construct
api.statement: Construct the frame torsor and normalization componentwise.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G02.characterise
api.statement: Identify ramification away from the open locus as horizontal boundary plus vertical fibers.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G02.transport
api.statement: Construct compatible level maps and base-field extensions.

uses.how: Uniform bad-prime control for all levels.

items.name: Uniform finiteness of vertical ramification
items.statement: If one closed stalk of L is unramified almost everywhere, then after choosing N divisible by p·|GL_n(Fp)| the union over m of vertical bad-prime sets of the frame covers is finite.

items.name: Unramifiedness propagates between closed points
items.statement: For a geometrically connected algebraic variety X over a number field E and a Qp local system L, if one closed stalk is unramified at almost all finite places then every closed stalk is unramified almost everywhere.

items.name: Local de Rham propagation in the algebraic case
items.statement: Under the hypotheses of Theorem1.1, de Rhamness at all places above p for one closed stalk implies the same for every closed stalk.

items.name: Global geometric rigidity
items.statement: Let X be a geometrically connected algebraic variety over a number field E and L a Qp étale local system. If L at one closed point is geometric in the Fontaine–Mazur sense, then L at every closed point is geometric.

items.name: Relative Fontaine–Mazur conjecture specification
items.statement: For geometrically connected algebraic X/E and a Qp local system having one geometric closed stalk, the relative Fontaine–Mazur conjecture predicts that the generic-stalk representation is a subquotient, up to Tate twist, of étale cohomology of some variety over the generic point. This item specifies a conjecture, not a proved target.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G07.construct
api.statement: Construct the geometric-origin predicate at the generic point with degree, Tate twist and subquotient data.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G07.characterise
api.statement: State the conjectural implication with its exact one-stalk hypothesis.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G07.transport
api.statement: Transport a supplied realization under finite generic-field extension.

uses.how: Prevent the proved rigidity theorem from being mislabeled motivic realization.

items.name: Abelian-monodromy relative Fontaine–Mazur case
items.statement: The relative Fontaine–Mazur prediction in G07 is known when the arithmetic monodromy is abelian, using finite geometric monodromy and the abelian case of Fontaine–Mazur.

items.name: Reflex norm of a torus cocharacter
items.statement: For a Q-torus T and cocharacter μ defined over a number field F, define Nμ:Res_(F/Q)Gm→Res_(F/Q)T_F→T by restriction of μ and multiplication over embeddings.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G09.construct
api.statement: Construct the restriction-of-scalars map and the torus norm.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G09.characterise
api.statement: Identify its splitting-field formula as the product of conjugate cocharacters.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G09.transport
api.statement: Prove finite-field-extension and torus-homomorphism compatibility.

uses.how: Torus reciprocity and special-point stalks.

items.name: Torus reciprocity and closure quotient
items.statement: Fix compact open K⊂T(Af). Global Artin with geometric-Frobenius normalization and Nμ gives r(μ)_K:Gal(Fab/F)→T(Q)\T(Af)/K. Passing to all levels gives r(μ) valued in T(Q)^−\T(Af), with T(Q)^− the adelic closure. Let F_K be fixed by ker r(μ)_K. Restrict the FULL r(μ) to Gal(Fab/F_K), giving values in K/(K∩T(Q)^−).

api.name: LiuZhu17.G10.construct
api.statement: Construct the finite-level reciprocity action and its field of definition.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G10.characterise
api.statement: Identify the inverse-limit action and its restriction to K modulo rational closure.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G10.transport
api.statement: Prove level and field-extension compatibility with the geometric Artin convention.

uses.how: Construct the stalk representation from the full reciprocity map.

items.name: p-adic torus reciprocity representation
items.statement: For an Q-rational algebraic representation ρ of T whose adelic realization kills K∩T(Q)^−, compose the full restricted reciprocity map G10 with ρ and project to p, obtaining r(μ,ρ)_(K,p) on Gal(Fbar/F_K).

api.name: LiuZhu17.G11.construct
api.statement: Construct the continuous representation after proving independence of closure representatives.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G11.characterise
api.statement: Identify its local characters after splitting T and the coefficient field.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G11.transport
api.statement: Prove tensor/dual and level-change compatibility.

uses.how: Special points supply geometric stalks.

items.name: Geometric torus reciprocity representations
items.statement: The p-adic torus reciprocity representation r(μ,ρ)_(K,p) is unramified at almost all finite places.

items.name: Local algebraic character criterion
items.statement: Let L,K/Qp be finite, ψ:G_L^ab→O_K× continuous, and V its underlying Qp representation. With arithmetic local Artin r_L, V is crystalline iff ψ∘r_L agrees on O_L× with a Qp-torus homomorphism Res_(L/Qp)Gm→Res_(K/Qp)Gm. Agreement only on an open unit subgroup yields potential crystallinity after finite extension.

items.name: The real-split anisotropic torus quotient
items.statement: For a Q-torus T, define T^a as the connected kernel of all Q-rational characters, T^s as the maximal Q-subtorus of T^a that is R-split, and T^c=T/T^s. For reductive G use Z_G^s in its center and G^c=G/Z_G^s.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G14.construct
api.statement: Construct the character-kernel torus, maximal split subtorus and quotient.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G14.characterise
api.statement: Characterize representations of G^c as representations of G trivial on Z_G^s.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G14.transport
api.statement: Prove functoriality for the torus inclusions and representation restriction used at special points.

uses.how: Correct quotient group for canonical local systems.

items.name: Closure criterion for the central quotient
items.statement: If an algebraic torus representation ρ kills K∩T(Q)^− for a compact open K, then ρ(T^s)=1.

items.name: Canonical Shimura local systems
items.statement: For a Shimura datum (G,X), sufficiently small neat K=K_pK^p and ρ∈Rep_Qp(G^c), choose a K_p-stable lattice Λ. Set K_p^(n)=K_p∩ρ^-1(1+p^nEndΛ), form the associated finite étale Λ/p^n sheaf on Sh_K, and take its inverse limit then rationalize.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G16.construct
api.statement: Construct the congruence-associated sheaves and compatible transition maps.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G16.characterise
api.statement: Prove independence of lattice after rationalization and identify Betti comparison for Q-rational ρ.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G16.transport
api.statement: Prove tensor, dual, level and Hecke compatibility over the reflex field.

uses.how: The existing canonical-local-system owner.

items.name: Canonical models and special-point supply
items.statement: For every Shimura datum, use the canonical model over its reflex field with geometric-Artin special-point reciprocity and algebraic level maps.

items.name: Special-point stalk identification
items.statement: For x=[h,a]_K and a Q-torus T_h containing h(S), identify the stalk of the canonical system with r(μ_h,ρ|T_h) at the induced torus level T_h(Af)∩aKa^-1, with the representation transported by a_p and restricted to the residue-field Galois group.

items.name: All Shimura canonical stalks are geometric
items.statement: For every Shimura datum and a representation of G^c defining the canonical Qp local system, its stalk at every closed point is geometric. For Q-rational V this is Theorem1.2; the §4.3 tensor construction and argument apply to Rep_Qp(G^c).

items.name: Canonical analytic de Rham torsor
items.statement: At v|p of the reflex field, the exact faithful tensor functor V↦D_dR(L_V,p) on Rep_Qp(G^c) defines a G^c torsor on Sh_K^ad over E_v. Its filtered refinement gives the parabolic reduction determined by the Hodge cocharacter class.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G20.construct
api.statement: Construct the tensor fiber functor and its isomorphism torsor.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G20.characterise
api.statement: Identify the filtration with a section of the associated flag/parabolic bundle.

api.name: LiuZhu17.G20.transport
api.statement: Prove pullback and Hecke transport of the torsor and filtration.

uses.how: Analytic automorphic output consumed by the later logarithmic comparison.

items.name: Tannakian torsor reconstruction
items.statement: For an affine algebraic group H over Qp and an exact faithful tensor functor Rep_Qp(H)→finite locally free modules on a ringed analytic base satisfying the standard fiber-functor hypotheses, the sheaf of tensor isomorphisms from the trivial fiber functor is an H-torsor; filtrations of a fixed cocharacter type give the corresponding parabolic reduction.

items.name: Pointwise period lattice and isocrystal class
items.statement: At a classical point, after embedding its algebraic residue closure in Cp, the filtered de Rham comparison gives a BdR+ lattice in V⊗BdR for every representation V of G^c. Applying the source-qualified Fargues modification/BKF tensor construction gives the associated class in B(G^c_Qp). A class in B(G_Qp) requires a lift or additional G-level input.

uses.how: Record the exact group of the Tannakian output without claiming a motivic crystalline realization.

items.name: Alternative geometric comparison illustrations
items.statement: The source explains an alternative route to de Rham comparison for abelian varieties using a CM elliptic curve with p split, rigidity on connected polarized moduli, and functorial cohomology; Fermat domination and Shioda–Katsura extend the argument to the indicated hypersurface cohomology.

items.name: Canonical unipotent cohomology comparison
items.statement: For every i≥0, inclusion M_K(Y)→M(geometric completed tower) induces an isomorphism in continuous Γgeom cohomology.

items.name: Higher Simpson direct-image vanishing
items.statement: For every Qp local system L on smooth X/k, R^qν′_*(hatL⊗OC)=0 for all q>0.

items.name: Simpson duality
items.statement: H(L∨)≃H(L)∨ with the negative-transpose Higgs field and dual Galois action.

items.name: Constant-system Hodge–Tate comparison
items.statement: For proper smooth X/k, H^i_et(X_Cp,Qp)⊗Cp≃⊕_(a+b=i) H^a(X,Ω^b_X)⊗k Cp(-b), with the Galois action and the source Hodge–Tate normalization.

items.name: Filtered-period higher direct-image vanishing
items.statement: For every allowed finite or infinite period interval [a,b], R^qν′_*(hatL⊗O_BdR^[a,b])=0 for q>0.

items.name: Arithmetic cohomological amplitude
items.statement: For smooth X/k and any Qp local system L, D^i_dR(L)=0 for i≥2.

items.name: Recovery of geometric RH from de Rham realization
items.statement: For a de Rham Qp local system L, RH(L)≃D^0_dR(L)hat⊗BdR compatibly with filtration, connection and Galois action.

items.name: Potential crystallinity of torus reciprocity
items.statement: The p-adic torus reciprocity representation r(μ,ρ)_(K,p) is potentially crystalline at each place above p.

items.name: Shrinking the level after the central quotient
items.statement: If ρ(T^s)=1, there is a sufficiently small compact open K with ρ(K∩T(Q)^−)=1.

items.name: Special points in every component
items.statement: Every geometric connected component of Sh_K(G,X) contains a special point.
